question: On which of the following dates did the United Nations observe the first World Clean Energy Day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fri Jan 26 2024 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Clean Energy Day** is a globally recognized observance dedicated to promoting sustainable and clean energy practices. It aims to raise awareness about the importance of transitioning from fossil fuels to renewable energy sources.
 
• The **United Nations** declared the first observation of World Clean Energy Day to be on **Fri Jan 26, 2024**. This date was chosen to highlight the urgency of addressing climate change and adopting cleaner energy solutions.
 
• The day emphasizes the global commitment to the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 7**, which focuses on ensuring access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all.
 
• The adoption of clean energy is critical for reducing **greenhouse gas emissions** and mitigating the adverse effects of global warming.
 
• The observance on January 26, 2024, includes numerous global initiatives such as conferences, clean energy showcases, and policy discussions to foster international cooperation in the energy sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Importance of Clean Energy:**

 
 
• **Clean energy** refers to energy derived from renewable sources such as solar, wind, hydropower, and geothermal. These sources produce minimal or no greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• Transitioning to clean energy is essential to combat **climate change**, reduce air pollution, and achieve global energy security.
 
• Clean energy technologies are becoming more affordable and accessible due to advancements in technology and increased investments in the sector.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 7:**
 
 
• SDG 7 is one of the 17 goals established by the **United Nations** in 2015 as part of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
 
• This goal aims to ensure universal access to affordable, reliable, and modern energy services by 2030.
 
• It also seeks to increase the share of renewable energy in the global energy mix and improve energy efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Global Clean Energy Initiatives:**
 
 
• The **International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA)** works to promote the widespread adoption of renewable energy globally.
 
• Key agreements such as the **Paris Agreement** emphasize the role of clean energy in reducing global carbon emissions.
 
• Several countries have launched national clean energy programs, such as India's **National Solar Mission** and the EU's **Green Deal**.
 
 
 
• **Challenges to Clean Energy Transition:**
 
 
• High initial investment costs for clean energy infrastructure remain a barrier for many developing nations.
 
• Energy storage and grid integration are technical challenges that need to be addressed to ensure the reliability of renewable energy systems.
 
• Global cooperation and policy alignment are crucial to overcoming these challenges and achieving a sustainable energy future.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Notable Observations:**

 
 
• The **International Energy Agency (IEA)** estimates that renewable energy sources will account for approximately **90% of the global power capacity additions** in the coming years.
 
• The global shift towards clean energy is expected to generate millions of jobs in the renewable energy sector, contributing to economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Key Dates and Events:**
 
 
• January 26, 2024, marks the first official observance of **World Clean Energy Day**, reinforcing the global commitment to sustainable energy practices.
 
• Countries around the world are organizing events such as clean energy expos, policy discussions, and educational programs to celebrate this day.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Benefits:**
 
 
• Switching to clean energy reduces **dependence on fossil fuels**, leading to a significant reduction in carbon emissions.
 
• It also helps in preserving natural ecosystems and improving air and water quality.
